# Design Folder

This folder contains UI design files managed by Phantoma Design tool.

## Structure

- `*.tsx` - React component files for each page/screen
- `Layout.tsx` - Shared layout wrapper
- `theme.tsx` - Theme configuration and utilities
- `site.ts` - Site-wide constants and configuration

## Usage

These files are compiled and previewed in real-time within the Design tab.
You can create new pages, edit existing ones, and see changes immediately.

---

**Platform**: Website (Desktop)
**Generated by**: Phantoma Design Tool
